meta.cardDescription: Receive leads from Meta (Facebook + Instagram) Lead Ads. n8n.lisent.ai routes by page_id; encrypted credentials per workspace.
meta.appIdHint: From your Meta App's Settings → Basic.
meta.appSecretHint: We encrypt this at rest with AES-GCM. n8n needs it to sign Graph API requests.
meta.pageAccessTokenHint: Long-lived page token from Graph API Explorer. Required when mock mode is off.
meta.mockModeHint: Skips Meta verification; lets you try the flow with synthetic test leads. Turn off when you have real Meta credentials.

meta.pageNameHint: Shown on the dashboard so you can recognise this page later.
meta.formIdsHint: Comma-separated. Empty = receive all forms on this page.
meta.fieldMappingHint: Map Meta lead-gen fields to CRM lead columns. Leave empty to use the default (full_name → name, email → email, phone_number → phone).
meta.n8nUrlHint: Paste this into Meta App → Webhooks → Page → leadgen subscription.
meta.webhookVerifyTokenHint: Meta sends this on the subscribe handshake so n8n can confirm the request is for your tenant.
meta.inboundUrlHint: n8n posts here after fetching the full lead from Meta. You don't need to paste this anywhere.
meta.hmacSecretHint: Save this now — we won't show the plaintext again.
meta.testLeadDescription: Synthesises a Meta-shaped payload and runs it through the same insert path as production. Available only while mock mode is on.
meta.disconnectDescription: Removes credentials and webhook subscription. Existing leads are kept.
meta.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Meta Lead Ads from this workspace?
meta.oauthScopeExplain: Authorize Lisent to read your Facebook + Instagram Lead Ads forms. We never post on your behalf and don't access anything outside Lead Ads.
